risk_description:
Due to discrepancies in the assembly process, there may be a misalignment between the gear teeth on the licence-plate holder and the swing arm. 
This may lead to the licence-plate holder being twisted and may subsequently cause the collar nut on the rear wheel spindle to loosen.
As a result, the licence-plate holder may become detached, leading to increased risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements of the General Product Safety Directive.
